## Overview
Lists the business's documents, newest first. Filter by client with `client` and by matter with `conversation_uid`. Each document says who it is from in `direction`.

### Staff Scoping
- Staff with organization access see all of the business's documents.
- Staff whose document access is `no` see none.
- Other staff see their own documents and the documents of clients they collaborate on.

The response is an array. Pagination totals are in the `Total`, `Per-Page` and `Link` response headers.

Available for **Staff tokens**.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Client UID. Returns only this client's documents (e.g., "c9i4nkl5tzp9o42k").

parameters.name: conversation_uid
parameters.description: Matter UID. Returns only the documents on this matter (e.g., "mt5f1c9a2b7d4e6q").

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1 (e.g., 1, 2).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of documents per page (e.g., 20, 50).

example.name: termite_warranty.pdf
example.title: One-year termite warranty
example.notes: Hi Dana, here is the warranty document we promised.

401.description: Unauthorized. The bearer token is missing, invalid, or not allowed to access the requested resource.

404.description: Not Found. The client or the matter does not exist.

post.description:
## Overview
Creates one document per file on a matter. Unless `direction` is `internal`, it also adds a message with the documents to the matter's conversation, so the client sees them in the client portal.

### Files
- Send files that are already in the business's library ("My documents", see `GET /v2/file_records`) as JSON, with their UIDs in `file_record_ids`.
- Upload new files as `multipart/form-data`, in `files[N][file]`.
- Both can be combined in one multipart request. Up to 10 files per request, up to 100 MB per file. ZIP files are rejected.

### Matter
Pass `conversation_id` (the matter UID) to send on one matter. With `client_id` instead, a copy is created on every matter of the client that the staff member can see.

### Email
With `shared_with_email: true`, the client also gets an email. When the client has no email address, no email is sent and the request still succeeds, so check the client's email first.

### Signature
The client is asked to sign when a library file's `signature_required` is true, or when `files[N][signature_required]` is true for an upload. The message is then a signature request.

Available for **Staff tokens**.

schema.description: Send library files. Pass `conversation_id` or `client_id`, and `file_record_ids`.

conversation_id.description: Matter UID to send the documents on. Prefer it over `client_id` (e.g., "mt5f1c9a2b7d4e6q").

client_id.description: Client UID. Creates a copy on every visible matter of the client (e.g., "c9i4nkl5tzp9o42k").

file_record_ids.description: UIDs of library files to send (e.g., ["fr7d2k9q4m1x8z3c"]).

message_text.description: Text of the message that goes with the documents. HTML is removed. Under 50,000 characters (e.g., "Hi Dana, here is the warranty document.").

shared_with_email.description: When true, the client also gets an email (e.g., true, false).

direction.description: `pivot_to_client` shares the documents with the client. `internal` stores them on the matter without a message (e.g., "pivot_to_client", "internal").

title.description: Document title. Used only when one file is sent (e.g., "One-year termite warranty").

staff_id.description: UID of the staff member the documents are sent as. Defaults to the token's staff member (e.g., "3so2q8r2b35x7phd").

example.message_text: Hi Dana, here is the warranty document we promised.

schema.description: Upload new files. Use the same top-level fields as the JSON body, plus `files[N][...]` for each file, starting at N = 0.

conversation_id.description: Matter UID to send the documents on (e.g., "mt5f1c9a2b7d4e6q").

message_text.description: Text of the message that goes with the documents (e.g., "Here are the photos.").

shared_with_email.description: When true, the client also gets an email (e.g., true, false).

file_record_ids[].description: UID of a library file to send with the uploads. Repeat the field for more files (e.g., "fr7d2k9q4m1x8z3c").

files[0][file].description: The file to upload (e.g., a PDF file).

files[0][signature_required].description: When true, the client is asked to sign the document (e.g., true, false).

files[0][template].description: When true, the file is also saved to the library ("My documents") (e.g., true, false).

200.description: The documents were created. One document per file and per matter.

data.name: termite_warranty.pdf
data.title: One-year termite warranty
data.notes: Hi Dana, here is the warranty document we promised.

401.description: Unauthorized. The bearer token is missing, invalid, or not allowed to access the requested resource.

403.description: Forbidden. The staff member may not send on this matter, or the business limits bulk actions and the request names more than one matter or client.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. A file or the message is invalid, the business has no document storage left, or the sharing limit is reached (`SHARE_ERROR`).

post.description:
## Overview
Uploads files as file records of the business, without attaching them to a client. A file record with `template` set is a library file ("My documents"): it appears in `GET /v2/file_records?templates_only=true`, and `POST /v2/documents` can send it to a client by its UID in `file_record_ids`. A file record without `template` is not listed in the library, but `POST /v2/documents` can still attach it to a matter by its UID.

Send the files as `multipart/form-data`, in `files[N][...]`, starting at N = 0. Up to 10 files per request, up to 100 MB per file. ZIP files are rejected. The file must have an extension, and its extension and content must be an allowed type (for example PDF, images, Office documents, text).

The file records belong to the staff member of the token. Staff without organization access see only their own file records.

Available for **Staff tokens**.

files[0][file].description: The file to upload (e.g., a PDF file).

files[0][template].description: When true, the file is a library file ("My documents") (e.g., true, false).

files[0][signature_required].description: When true, the client is asked to sign the document each time it is sent (e.g., true, false).

200.description: The file records were created. One item per file.

401.description: Unauthorized. The bearer token is missing, invalid, or not allowed to access the requested resource.

403.description: Forbidden. The staff member may not upload files.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. No file was sent, more than 10 files were sent, a file type or name is not allowed, or the business has no document storage left.

example.message: This file type is not allowed

## Overview
Submits Leave Details Form to the business.

## Authentication
**Available for Client Tokens only.**

## Required Fields
Before submitting, call `GET /client_api/v1/portals/{business_uid}/contact/get_form` to discover required fields for the business's form configuration.

For the default `leave_details` form, `subject` and `message` are typically required fields. Any field marked with `required: true` in the form response must be provided with a non-empty value, or the API returns HTTP 422.

## Request Body Structure
The `form_data.fields` object is a dynamic map where keys are field IDs and values are the field values. Field IDs can be obtained from the GET form response.

parameters.name: business_uid
parameters.description: business_uid

form_data.description: Form data containing field values. This is an object (NOT an array) with a 'fields' property.

fields.description: Dynamic map of field IDs to values. Field IDs include fixed keys like 'subject' and 'message', plus any custom field IDs from the form configuration. Get valid field IDs from GET /client_api/v1/portals/{business_uid}/contact/get_form.

example.subject: Contact inquiry
example.message: Hello, I would like more information

isWidget.description: Whether the form was submitted from a widget. **Must be a boolean value (true/false), not a string.**

422.description: Validation Error - Empty or missing required fields. Use GET .../contact/get_form to discover required field IDs.

post.description:
## Overview
Submits Share Documents Form to the business.

## Authentication
**Available for Client Tokens only.**

## Critical Requirement
The `matter_uid` query parameter must reference a matter with an assigned staff member. Without this, the endpoint returns 500 due to a server-side bug.

## Request Format
This endpoint requires `multipart/form-data` format with actual binary file uploads (not JSON). Documents must be uploaded as form fields with proper content types.

## Important: Field Naming Convention
**Document fields MUST use explicit numeric indices** (e.g., `[0]`, `[1]`), NOT empty brackets `[]`.

- Correct: `form_data[fields][documents][0]=@file.pdf`
- Wrong: `form_data[fields][documents][]=@file.pdf` (causes 500 error)

This is because the server expects a Hash structure, not an Array.

## Captcha
When the business has the `captcha_intake_form` feature enabled, a valid `captcha_token` is required.

## Example cURL
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.vcita.biz/client_api/v1/portals/{business_uid}/share_documents_form/submit?matter_uid={matter_uid}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer {token}' \
  -F 'form_data[fields][title]=My Document' \
  -F 'form_data[fields][message]=Please review' \
  -F 'form_data[fields][documents][0]=@file.pdf;type=application/pdf'
```

parameters.name: matter_uid
parameters.description: The matter/conversation UID to associate with the document upload. **Critical**: The matter must have an assigned staff member to avoid 500 errors.

form_data[fields][documents][0].description: File to upload. **Important**: Use explicit indices `[0]`, `[1]`, etc. - NOT empty brackets `[]`. For multiple files, use `form_data[fields][documents][0]`, `form_data[fields][documents][1]`, etc.

captcha_token.description: reCAPTCHA token. Required when business has captcha_intake_form feature enabled.

422.description:
Validation Error or Business Blocked.

**Validation Error**: Missing required fields like documents.

**Business Blocked**: When the business is flagged as spammer or user access is blocked, returns 422 with NO explicit error message - only `auto_reply_message` in the data object.

500.description: Internal Server Error. Occurs when the matter does not have an assigned staff member or when an empty JSON body is sent instead of multipart/form-data.

## Overview
Searches for docuforms (documents and forms) activities within the business. Results are scoped based on the requesting staff member's permissions.

### Staff Scoping
- **Admin staff** (with full client access): Can see all docuforms activities, unless `teams_view_filter=me` is specified.
- **Non-admin staff**: Can only see their own docuforms activities, unless they have shared view access.

Available for **Staff and Internal tokens**.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search text to match against docuforms data. Defaults to `*` (all) if not provided.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (1-based).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of results per page.

parameters.name: select_all
parameters.description: When set to true, returns all matching docuforms without pagination limits.

parameters.name: teams_view_filter
parameters.description: When set to `me`, restricts results to only the current staff member's docuforms, even if the staff has admin access.

parameters.name: signature_status
parameters.description: Filter by signature status. Common values include: pending, awaiting_signature, sent, signed, declined.

post.description:
Create a new file for the specified business. The API returns immediately with status='pending'. File processing (virus scan, S3 upload, thumbnail generation) happens asynchronously in the background.

If a duplicate file is detected via SHA-256 content hash, the existing file is returned immediately with status='uploaded'.

Rate limit: 10 uploads per user per 10 minutes. Maximum file size: 100MB.

Available for **Staff and Client tokens**.

200.description: Duplicate file detected - existing file returned immediately (no processing needed)

data.description: Represents a file uploaded to the platform. Files go through an asynchronous processing pipeline including virus scanning, S3 storage, and thumbnail generation. Content deduplication via SHA-256 fingerprinting ensures efficient storage within each business.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the file record (e.g., "file_123").

business_uid.description: Unique identifier of the business that owns this file (e.g., "biz_456").

name.description: Original filename including extension (e.g., "document.pdf", "photo.jpg"). Maximum length is 255 characters.

content_type.description: MIME type of the uploaded file. One of the allowed types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp, image/svg+xml, application/pdf, application/msword, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document (.docx), application/vnd.ms-excel, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet (.xlsx), application/vnd.ms-powerpoint, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation (.pptx), text/plain, text/csv, video/mp4, video/webm, video/quicktime (.mov), audio/mpeg, audio/wav, application/zip (e.g., "application/pdf", "image/jpeg").

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes. Maximum allowed size is 104857600 bytes (100MB).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint (64-character hexadecimal string) used for content deduplication within the same business. Files with identical content_hash skip redundant processing (e.g., "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855").

status.description:
Current processing status of the file. **pending**: Upload received, virus scan queued. **scanning**: Virus scan in progress. **scanned**: Virus scan passed, awaiting S3 upload. **uploaded**: S3 upload complete, thumbnails generated if applicable. **infected**: Malware detected, file marked for deletion. **failed**: Processing error occurred (scan or upload failure). **linked**: File has active entity relations. **deleted**: Soft deleted. The file's S3 objects (original and thumbnails) are removed immediately; the record is retained as soft-deleted and excluded from all reads.

A background job also purges files automatically: any file stuck in 'pending' or 'scanning' for more than 2 hours, and any 'uploaded' file with no active relation for more than 5 hours, are soft-deleted the same way. Link a file promptly after upload to keep it from being purged.

metadata.description: Optional JSON object containing arbitrary key-value pairs for additional file metadata (e.g., {"source": "chat", "uploaded_by_name": "John Doe"}).

url.description: Pre-signed S3 URL for downloading the original file. Available when status is 'uploaded' or 'linked'. Null for pending/failed files (e.g., "https://s3.amazonaws.com/files-bucket/path/to/original?signature=...").

thumbnail_url.description: Pre-signed S3 URL for the thumbnail scaled to 400px height, with width following the source's aspect ratio (never upscaled). Available for images and, as a poster frame, for videos, after successful processing. Null for other file types or pending uploads (e.g., "https://s3.amazonaws.com/files-bucket/path/to/thumb_400.jpg?signature=...").

thumbnail_small_url.description: Pre-signed S3 URL for the thumbnail scaled to 150px height, with width following the source's aspect ratio (never upscaled). Available for images and, as a poster frame, for videos, after successful processing. Null for other file types or pending uploads (e.g., "https://s3.amazonaws.com/files-bucket/path/to/thumb_150.jpg?signature=...").

created_by.description: Type of actor who created this file. **staff**: Uploaded by a staff member. **client**: Uploaded by a client.

created_by_uid.description: Unique identifier of the staff member or client who uploaded this file (e.g., "staff_789", "client_456").

created_at.description: Timestamp when the file record was created, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2026-01-27T10:30:00Z").

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the file record was last updated, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2026-01-27T11:00:00Z").

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the file was soft deleted, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2026-01-27T12:00:00Z"). Null if not deleted. On deletion the file's S3 objects (including thumbnails) are removed immediately; the record is retained as soft-deleted.

201.description: File upload initiated successfully (new file, async processing started)

Retrieves the files you uploaded, optionally filtered by status or a list of file UIDs. Each token only sees files it created itself; files uploaded by other users are not returned. Results include pre-signed URLs for file download and thumbnails when the file is ready. Soft-deleted files are never returned.

Available for **Staff and Client tokens**.

parameters.description: Number of files per page (default: 20, max: 100).

post.description:
Links an existing file to a business entity (e.g., an invoice, message, or meeting). The referenced file must already exist and must not be infected, failed, or deleted; linking is allowed while the file is still processing ('pending', 'scanning') as well as once ready ('scanned', 'uploaded', 'linked'). If the file is later found infected or fails processing, any relation created for it is retracted. Once a file has at least one active relation its status becomes 'linked', protecting it from cleanup.

The caller must have access to the related entity: a Staff token is checked directly against the entity. A Client token is checked by querying the client's own activity on that entity — the entity must appear in the client's activity feed (matched by message text for entity_type='message', or by activity type for every other entity type). Any error or timeout from that check is treated as no access (fails closed).

For **Client tokens**, the client_uid is derived from the token and any value supplied in the body is ignored. For **Staff tokens**, client_uid may be provided to associate the relation with a specific client; omitting it returns a 400.

Available for **Staff and Client tokens**.

get.description:
Retrieves the file relations for a given entity, each including the linked file's details. Results are paginated.

Staff access is scoped to the linked entity: a staff sees relations for any entity they can access, regardless of who uploaded the file. Client access is scoped to the client's own relations. In both cases, no access to the entity is not an error — it returns an empty list (`total: 0`), indistinguishable from the entity genuinely having no relations.

Available for **Staff and Client tokens**.

parameters.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of relations per page (default: 20).
